surfaces.label: Landing
surfaces.purpose: Public product landing — sign in or jump to Command Deck when already authenticated.
operate: Open `http://<host>:30742/`.
**Sign in** → `/login`, or **Open Command Deck** if you already have a session.
Read the Deploy Postgres + Keycloak story only as orientation — day-2 work lives under `/deck`.
**Empty / fail:** Page blank → console NodePort / ingress; not a substitute for Keycloak admin.
**Success:** You can reach Login or Deck without certificate/network surprises.

surfaces.label: Login
surfaces.purpose: Sign in to the Haven identity console — lab demo, local console user, or Keycloak admin.
operate: Open `http://<host>:30742/login`.
Lab: `demo` / `demo` when `HAVEN_LAB_LOGIN` is enabled.
Or Keycloak admin / `HAVEN_CONSOLE_USER`+`PASSWORD`.
**Sign in** — failures show an inline error.
**Empty / fail:** Wrong password → check `haven-keycloak-admin` secret; lab demo cannot change its own password.
**Success:** Redirect to Command Deck; sidebar shows Keycloak connected status.

surfaces.label: Command Deck
surfaces.purpose: Home operations surface — Keycloak connection, IdentityPlane health cards, reconcile timeline.
operate: Land on `/deck` after sign-in.
Read **Connected Keycloak** strip (URL, version, realm count).
Scan orbit cards: Keycloak, Phase, Postgres, backup, certificate, login RPS.
Follow **Reconcile Timeline** conditions (DatabaseReady, KeycloakReady, …).
Quick links: Realm Studio, Clients, Deploy wizard, Settings.
If offline: **Connect Keycloak** / Settings → Test & connect.
**Empty / fail:** Not connected → Settings; external plane may show Ready with Postgres `external` — expected.
**Success:** Connected banner + Ready phase (or understood external mode).

surfaces.label: Deploy wizard
surfaces.purpose: Spin up an identity plane — Postgres + Keycloak via Haven compose path.
operate: Open `/deploy`.
Walk profile / capacity steps in the wizard.
**Review & Deploy →** when ready; watch toast and Deck reconcile timeline.
Return to Planes / Deck to confirm Phase Ready.
**Empty / fail:** Deploy failed toast → operators/RBAC/storage; use external Keycloak via Settings instead.
**Success:** Plane appears Ready; Keycloak reachable from Settings.

surfaces.label: Planes
surfaces.purpose: IdentityPlane instances — health, profile, and endpoints.
operate: Open `/planes`.
**+ Deploy plane** or **Deploy wizard** when empty.
Open a plane card → endpoints / health; jump **Open Command Deck**.
**Empty / fail:** No planes → Deploy wizard or connect external Keycloak in Settings.
**Success:** Fleet card shows Ready with Keycloak/Postgres endpoints.

surfaces.label: Atlas
surfaces.purpose: Traffic path to identity — Console → Ingress → Keycloak → Postgres.
operate: Open `/atlas`.
Walk the path diagram; confirm each hop looks healthy.
Use this before debugging OIDC redirect or login failures.
**Empty / fail:** Broken hop → Settings connection or ingress NodePorts.
**Success:** Path matches your deploy (console 30742 → Keycloak 30180 typical).

surfaces.label: Realm Studio
surfaces.purpose: Create and manage Keycloak realms as tenant boundaries.
operate: Open `/realms`.
**+ Create realm** → name → Create.
Open a row → `/realms/:realm` for users/clients tabs.
Delete realm only with confirm (destructive).
**Empty / fail:** No realms → create one; Keycloak offline → Settings.
**Success:** Realm listed and openable in detail.

surfaces.label: Realm detail
surfaces.purpose: Users and clients inside one realm — invite, set password, mint/rotate secrets.
operate: Open a realm from `/realms`.
Users: **+ Invite user**; set password via dialog when offered.
Clients: create/manage; **Regenerate client secret** with confirm; copy secret once.
**Empty / fail:** Invite fails → Keycloak permissions; secret regenerate is irreversible.
**Success:** User can authenticate to the realm; client secret pasted into your app.

surfaces.label: Clients
surfaces.purpose: OIDC clients across all realms — mint, rotate secrets, manage redirect URIs.
operate: Open `/clients`.
Filter by realm; create or edit clients (redirect URIs, public/confidential).
Rotate secrets carefully; copy the new secret immediately.
**Empty / fail:** Empty list → create realm first; 403 → console role.
**Success:** Client appears with correct redirect URI for your app callback.

surfaces.label: Settings
surfaces.purpose: Connect Haven to Keycloak and manage console appearance / passwords.
operate: Open `/settings`.
Enter Keycloak URL → **Test & connect**; expect green Connected banner.
Change console password or Keycloak admin password via dialogs (persist secrets before restart).
Open Keycloak SPI console link when connected.
**Empty / fail:** Connection failed → URL/network/admin creds; lab demo cannot change its password.
**Success:** `Connected to … · v… · N realms`; Deck status goes green.
